decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, by reason of their size, position and appearance would represent an obtrusive and unsympathetic development, which would project significantly beyond the building line of Upper Sutton Lane on this prominent corner. The proposals would therefore be harmful to the character and appearance of the streetscene, and also to the living conditions of adjoining occupiers, by reason of enclosure, loss of outlook and light, overlooking and increased noise and activity, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 2 - The proposal would fail to provide any private amenity space and would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would result in substandard living accommodation due to inadequate room sizes and layout, detrimental to the living conditions of future occupiers, and contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 and H 4.1. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 3 - The proposed parking arrangements would fail to meet the Council's parking standards by reason of insufficient number of spaces and inadequate layout, which would result in unacceptable pedestrian and cyclist access to the site, and in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policy T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
description: Erection of a two-storey side extension and roof extension to shop forming an extension to shop at ground floor and creation of 2 one bed flats at first and roof levels
